newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers higher, 180-cst traded at $123/T.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers higher, 180-cst traded at $123/T.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Tuesday were slightly higher but were likely to edge lower as competitive prices in Colombo may draw away some demand, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at $119-$122 per tonne and 180-cst supplies at around $123-$126 per tonne. Quotes on Monday were at $117-$119 for 380-cst and $122-$124 for 180-cst.
A local shipowner said he had purchased a 400 tonne-parcel of 180-cst at $123 per tonne.
MDO prices were little changed at $223-228 and gas oil at $234-$238. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
